questions.title: GMT to Cairo
questions.question: It is 8:00 AM at Greenwich. What time is it in Cairo (30° East)?
questions.explanation:
Step 1: 30° ÷ 15 = 2 Hours.
Step 2: East is Ahead. Add.
Step 3: 8:00 + 2 = 10:00 AM.

questions.title: Ghana to Uganda
questions.question: Accra (Ghana) is at 0°. Uganda is approx 45° East. If it is 2:00 PM in Accra, what time is it in Kampala?
questions.explanation:
Step 1: 45° ÷ 15 = 3 Hours.
Step 2: Uganda is East of Ghana. Add time.
Step 3: 2:00 PM + 3 hours = 5:00 PM.

questions.title: London to Mauritius
questions.question: It is 1:00 PM in London. What time is it in Mauritius (60° East)?

questions.title: Finding Longitude
questions.question: It is 12:00 Noon at GMT. It is 6:00 PM at City Y. Where is City Y located?
questions.explanation:
Step 1: Time diff = 6 hours.
Step 2: 6 × 15 = 90°.
Step 3: Time is Ahead (PM), so it must be East.
Answer: 90° East.
